issues.issue: Does the Federal Court have jurisdiction under section 42 of the Act to review a government institution's subsection 9(1) extension decision?
issues.applicant_position: Federal Court has jurisdiction to review extensions as they can amount to deemed refusals under subsection 10(3).
issues.respondent_position: Federal Court lacks jurisdiction; sections 41 and 42 limit review to refusals, excluding extensions.
issues.result_text: Federal Court had jurisdiction to review DND's extension and consider its validity.

issues.issue: If the Federal Court has jurisdiction, was the Department of National Defence's 1,110-day extension under subsection 9(1) valid and reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: Extension was invalid; 230-day part unjustified and 880-day part unreasonably long and based on flawed calculations.
issues.respondent_position: Extension was reasonable given circumstances, consultations, and operational challenges; Federal Court judge correctly upheld it.
issues.result_text: DND's extension did not meet subsection 9(1) requirements and was invalid.
